{{Top|leg}}
A '''death wave''' was a series of massive tidal waves that could occur on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The death wave was triggered by [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] under the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floor.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

In [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]], a death wave, only the fifth in recorded history on Chad, swept across the planet. The resulting [[Chadran disaster|disaster]] killed hundreds of thousands of [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]]<ref name="EGTAS" /> and destroyed a significant amount of the Chadrian civilization.<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref>
